verdict.rationale: Anthropic's own docs explicitly list writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts, and updating dependencies as core Claude Code use cases, backed by git/GitHub integration for PRs and CI hooks. However, multiple hands-on community reports describe unreliable self-verification, careless replace_all edits corrupting code, and degraded output quality over time, suggesting real-world execution doesn't always match the polished doc description.
